module: Handler for the 'hubWheelsTSV' wheel type: a wheel with a separate hub WITHOUT simulated air pressure: the tire is linked to the hub by anisotropic side and reinforcement beams (instead of pressurized beams). Called by jbeam/sections/wheels.lua during vehicle loading.
usage: -- called by the dispatcher: process(vehicle, wheelKey, wheel)
notes: Per ray, the code creates: tread (BEAM_ANISOTROPIC), periphery (NORMALTYPE), hub beams (tread, periphery, axle toward node1/node2), 2 anisotropic hub-tire reinforcements (wheelReinforcementBeam*), 4 anisotropic side beams (wheelSideBeam*), and BEAM_SUPPORT (7) support beams if enableTireSideSupportBeams.
The node creation order is reversed compared to hubWheelsTSI (inner then outer for the hub): the 'outhub' and 'inhub' nodes are swapped in the indices.
Result: wheel.nodes (hub nodes), wheel.reinforcementBeams, wheel.sideBeams, wheel.treadBeams. Default values: radius 0.5, hubRadius 0.65*radius, numRays 10. wheel.collision is forced to true.
In this handler, hubWidth/tireWidth are not written to the wheel (unlike TSI).
C constants: NORMALTYPE 0, BEAM_ANISOTROPIC 1, BEAM_SUPPORT 7; no BEAM_PRESSURED.

process.desc: Creates nodes and beams of a hubWheelsTSV wheel (alias of addHubWheelTSV). Warning 'invalid hubWheel' and exits if node1 or node2 is missing.

wheelKey.desc: index of the wheel in its section

wheel.desc: jbeam definition of the wheel (modified: collision, radius, hubRadius, numRays, nodes, reinforcementBeams, sideBeams, treadBeams)
